items.question: States one clear learning goal in a single line before the visualization.
items.2: one concrete line at the top

items.question: Offers guided 'try this' experiments tied to specific controls.
items.2: 1-3 concrete experiments naming controls and expected changes

items.question: Prompts what the learner should notice.
items.2: specific 'what you should notice' callout linked to the visual

items.question: Shows the formula with a plain-language meaning (when a formula applies).
items.1: formula or explanation but not both
items.2: formula plus plain-language meaning of each symbol

items.question: Includes a check-understanding question or practice item.
items.2: interactive or answerable question with feedback

items.question: Honestly labels the model as simplified and avoids invented facts.
items.2: explicit simplification note, no fabricated claims

duplicateNote: Share of surface text (excluding required fallbackText) repeated in the markdown blocks.
